messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — cross-region routing + DNS TTL flaps caused a cascade of 5m retries yesterday. I'm collecting owners/timelines for remediation items. Please reply with owners and ETA. (postmortem ref: PM-2026-03-22)

Sam: I'll own LB routing circuit-breaker + canary fallback. Plan: implement route priority + 2min circuit timeout and feature flag. ETA: 2026-04-02. Will open PR to eng-runtime and link tests.

Priya: I'll take DNS TTL consistency checks and zone config cleanup. Found one zone with 30s TTL (not intended). Will standardize to 300s where safe and add presubmit lint for zone files. ETA: 2026-03-30. I'll post change list in #eng-dns.

Jordan: I'll coordinate Dedicated region routing policy changes and the canary test plan. Need an infra maintenance window — suggest 2026-03-31. Will produce a canary checklist.

Ken: I'll add split alarm + an aggregated cross-region retry ratio metric in Datadog and attach a runbook. ETA: 2026-03-29. Runbook will include detection thresholds and rollback steps.

Maria: Two more asks: (1) can someone capture the recurring pattern note for the incident tracker (we've seen TTL-induced oscillation twice in 6 weeks)? (2) Add explicit rollback criteria for route policy rollouts.

Sam: I'll add the recurring-pattern note to the incident tracker and link both older events. Also adding rollback criteria: >5% cross-region retries sustained for 10m triggers immediate rollback.

Priya: Quick data point from one affected edge, pasted dig output: 
```
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 53421
;; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 1, AUTHORITY: 2, ADDITIONAL: 1
;; ANSWER SECTION:
redwood.example.com. 30 IN A 10.0.0.12
```
This matches the 30s TTL we saw.

Jordan: @DeployBot — schedule canary for route-policy-2026-03-31 at 03:00 UTC? Need to notify eng-oncall and product.

DeployBot: Scheduled canary 'route-policy-2026-03-31' at 2026-03-31T03:00:00Z. Notifying eng-oncall.

OpsBot: Note: provisional runbook created at /runbooks/lb-crossregion-retries. Please add owners and verification steps. (private)

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll synthesize this into the postmortem follow-up doc and ping ENG leads for weekly check-ins. Target to close action items by 2026-04-07 unless owners request extensions. :thumbsup:

Sam: ack
Priya: ack
Jordan: ack
Ken: ack
